  counter <$M> · accept · walk           e.g. "counter 6.6" (pre-money valuation in $ millions)
  leave <site#>                          break a site's lease: 1 month's rent, its machines are sold
  loan <amount>                          borrow against your machines, e.g. "loan 5000" (1 Bandwidth)
  repay [construction|bridge]            pay the equipment (or construction, or bridge) loan off early
  cloan <btc|eth> <amount>               pledge treasury coins and borrow, e.g. "cloan eth 5000" (1 Bandwidth, 2018Q1–2022Q2)
  crepay                                 repay the crypto loan and get the coins back
  renew <site#> [fixed|index]            accept a due power contract renewal's opening offer (0 Bandwidth)
  negotiate <site#> [4|8] [fixed|index]  negotiate a due renewal instead (2 Bandwidth), then:
  counter <cents> · accept · walk        e.g. "counter 5.2" (price in ¢/kWh)

event.ec01_ftx_contagion.title: The Exchange That Wasn't
event.ec01_ftx_contagion.body: An exchange everyone trusted just imploded overnight. Crypto lenders freeze withdrawals, and every crypto-backed loan desk has gone dark. Your coins are worth a lot less by Monday.
event.ec01_ftx_contagion.body_news: An exchange everyone trusted just imploded overnight. Crypto lenders freeze withdrawals and every crypto-backed loan desk goes dark. You hold no coins, so you watch from the side.
event.ec01_ftx_contagion.choice.sell: Sell the treasury now, lock in the loss
event.ec01_ftx_contagion.hint.sell: Sell all your BTC and ETH at this week's prices.
event.ec01_ftx_contagion.choice.hold: Hold and wait for a bounce
event.ec01_ftx_contagion.hint.hold: Keep the coins and ride the price. Either way, credit ratings drop a notch for two quarters.
event.ec02_chatgpt_rumor.title: A Chatbot Everyone's Talking About
event.ec02_chatgpt_rumor.body: Your nephew won't stop showing you what some new chatbot wrote. Feels like a toy. A few customers start asking odd questions about 'inference workloads.'

event.ec02_chatgpt_rumor.hint.prepare: $50K for advisers and 1 Bandwidth next quarter.
event.ec04_svb_freeze.title: Your Bank Just Failed
event.ec04_svb_freeze.body: A regional bank that half the tech industry banked with is gone by Friday. Regulators say deposits are safe. Nobody quite believes it, and nobody will write new loans next quarter.
event.ec04_svb_freeze.choice.move: Move cash to a bigger bank now
event.ec04_svb_freeze.hint.move: Costs $20K and a week of fuss.
event.ec04_svb_freeze.hint.ride: Free, but your credit rating drops a notch for two quarters.
event.ec06_ordinals_fee_spike.title: A Strange Fee Windfall
event.ec06_ordinals_fee_spike.body: Something called 'Ordinals' has clogged the mempool with tiny inscriptions, and fees have spiked to a two-year high. Your miners are printing extra for a few weeks.
event.ec06_ordinals_fee_spike.body_news: Something called 'Ordinals' has clogged the bitcoin mempool and fees spike to a two-year high. You have no miners running to cash in.
event.ec06_ordinals_fee_spike.hint.bank: +8% of this quarter's mining revenue so far.
event.ec07_etf_rally.title: Wall Street Shows Up
event.ec07_etf_rally.body: Eleven bitcoin ETFs launch on the same day. Institutional money starts flowing in a way your industry has never seen. Your treasury looks a lot better this morning.
event.ec07_etf_rally.body_news: Eleven bitcoin ETFs launch on the same day and institutional money flows in. You hold no coins to sell into it.
event.ec07_etf_rally.hint.sell: Sell 30% of your BTC and ETH at this week's prices.
event.ec08_halving_night.title: The Halving
event.ec08_halving_night.body: Block 840,000. Overnight, every block your machines mine pays half as much new coin. Some of your older ASICs are now mining at a loss.
event.ec08_halving_night.body_news: Block 840,000: the block reward halves overnight. Miners everywhere switch off their oldest machines.
event.ec08_halving_night.hint.switch_off: Machines that lose money stop, as always.
event.ec08_halving_night.hint.keep_runni: Mining revenue −10% for the rest of the quarter.
event.ec09_pivot_premium.title: The Market Notices
event.ec09_pivot_premium.body: Your first AI deal is signed, and analysts are calling this quarter's theme 'miners pivoting.' Your numbers look different to the market now.
event.ec09_pivot_premium.hint.pr_push: $100K; your operating value counts 5% more for 4 quarters.
event.ec09_pivot_premium.choice.quiet: Let the deal speak for itself
event.ec09_pivot_premium.hint.quiet: The pivot premium on your mining multiple applies either way.
event.ec10_pjm_shock.title: Your Power Bill Is About to Jump
event.ec10_pjm_shock.body: The regional grid operator's capacity auction just cleared at nearly nine times last year's price. Every megawatt you run in the region costs more from next quarter.
event.ec10_pjm_shock.hint.absorb: Power at your Virginia and Ohio (PJM) sites × 1.3 for 4 quarters, from next quarter.
event.ec10_pjm_shock.hint.lobby: No price rise, but 1 Bandwidth next quarter and +10 Heat at those sites.
event.ec11_warrenton_backlash.title: The Council Lost Its Seats
event.ec11_warrenton_backlash.body: Every council member in a nearby county who backed a big data-center project just lost re-election. Your neighbours are watching what you build next.
event.ec11_warrenton_backlash.hint.scale: −10 Heat at your PJM site, 1 Bandwidth next quarter.
event.ec12_stargate_rfp.title: A Half-Trillion-Dollar Rumor

event.ec12_stargate_rfp.hint.bid: 2 Bandwidth next quarter; each project without a tenant gets a fresh set of offers, one more than usual.
event.ec13_deepseek_wobble.title: A Cheap Model Spooks the Market
event.ec13_deepseek_wobble.body: A little-known lab just released a model that reportedly cost a fraction of what everyone assumed to train. Nvidia loses more than half a trillion dollars of value in a day. The end of the build-out, or a blip?
event.ec13_deepseek_wobble.hint.hedge: Your weakest building project goes live a quarter later.
event.ec13_deepseek_wobble.hint.stay: Nothing changes. Either way, AI demand −10 and the AI multiple −3 for two quarters.
event.ec13_deepseek_wobble.hint.buy_dip: GPUs 10% cheaper in next quarter's Plan phase; 1 Bandwidth next quarter.
event.ec14_coreweave_ipo_news.title: A Neocloud Goes Public
event.ec14_coreweave_ipo_news.body: The GPU-cloud pioneer everyone's been watching just went public, priced below the range but with a backlog that makes your eyes water. AI-infra valuations are the story of the quarter.
event.ec15_spot_price_shock.title: Compute Just Got Cheaper
event.ec15_spot_price_shock.body: A hyperscaler just cut its GPU rental prices by nearly a third. Every uncontracted GPU-hour you were about to sell on spot is worth less this afternoon.

event.ec16_backstop_offer.hint.accept: The backstop goes on your first eligible lease, for warrants in the company.
event.ec17_jv_partner_offer.title: A Private-Credit JV

event.ec17_jv_partner_offer.hint.take: The partner funds 65% of the equity for 65% of the project.
event.ec18_depreciation_debate.title: How Long Does a GPU Really Last?
event.ec18_depreciation_debate.body: A well-known short-seller argues this whole industry understates how fast GPUs lose value. Nvidia pushes back hard two weeks later. Which depreciation schedule do you file under?
event.ec18_depreciation_debate.body_news: A well-known short-seller argues the AI industry understates how fast GPUs lose value; Nvidia pushes back. You own no GPU clusters.

ui.act2_intro.label: Act II · The Pivot and the Boom
ui.act2_intro.title: Q4 2022. Ethereum no longer pays miners. ChatGPT launches next month.
ui.act2_intro.body: Four years, 2022 to 2026: turn your energized megawatts into AI capacity, or ride bitcoin through the halving. Your company carries over as it is.
ui.act2_intro.lifeline_title: A bankrupt miner's site, going cheap
ui.act2_intro.lifeline_body: A rival just filed Chapter 11. Its {siteKw} site goes to auction for {priceUsd} with the lights still on. A bridge lender offers {loanUsd} at {aprPct} for {quarters} quarters: enough for the site, leaving you {cashUsd} in cash. Interest every week, the whole loan due at the end.
ui.act2_intro.lifeline_take: Bid with the bridge loan and begin Act II →
ui.act2_intro.head_start.sell_gpus_keep_: Sold {count} GPU rigs for {valueUsd}. Lean operations: mining power costs {leanPct} less for {leanQuarters} quarters. In {fleetQuarter} a bankrupt miner's fleet (up to {fleetKw} of S19-class machines) is yours for {fleetPct} of the new price. Handicap: your first AI project builds a quarter longer, and you have no GPU know-how until your first cluster is live.
ui.act2_intro.head_start.gpu_cloud: {count} GPU rigs rent out as a small GPU cloud (${usdHr} a GPU-hour at {utilPct} use). GPU know-how 1: the first AI tenants call from {tenantsFrom} (others wait until {tenantsLater}), and your first cluster builds a quarter faster. From {cloudOfferFrom} a neocloud always bids for your GPU cloud projects, and your first pilot skips the GPU queue scare. Handicap: the old cards barely earn more than their power.
ui.act2_intro.head_start.hosting: Sold {count} GPU rigs for {valueUsd} and turned {hostedKw} of GPU halls into hosting for {costUsd}: other miners pay {rateCents}¢/kWh all-in for {termQuarters} quarters. Those sites are shell-ready: an AI shell there costs {discountPct} less and builds a quarter faster. From {shellOfferFrom} an AA-rated hyperscaler always bids for your AI shells. Handicap: ending hosting early costs a quarter of fees.
ui.act2_intro.head_start.sell_gpus_keep_: No GPUs to sell. Lean operations: mining power costs {leanPct} less for {leanQuarters} quarters. In {fleetQuarter} a bankrupt miner's fleet (up to {fleetKw} of S19-class machines) is yours for {fleetPct} of the new price. Handicap: your first AI project builds a quarter longer.
ui.act2_intro.head_start.gpu_cloud_none: You had no GPU rigs to keep, so there's no legacy cloud: no early GPU know-how and no early tenants.
ui.act2_intro.head_start.hosting_none: You had no GPU halls to convert: no hosting and no shell-ready sites. From {shellOfferFrom} an AA-rated hyperscaler still always bids for your AI shells.
ui.act2_intro.head_start.hold_and_wait: Your GPU rigs are parked: no power, no revenue, their resale value slowly falling. Sell them at any Plan phase, for {premiumPct} more in {premiumFrom}–{premiumTo} while GPUs are scarce. With nothing to run you get +1 Bandwidth in your first two quarters.
